fusions.name: Sees the Soft Place
fusions.desc: Your tongue hits the first enemy in its path up to 8 tiles away for 30 damage. The hit is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Flat Stare
fusions.desc: Fixes both bulging eyes on everything in a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 35% chance to leave each target [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gauged to the Inch
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
